query: How can I get my road widening plan approved by the PWD in Tamil Nadu?
reference_answer:
Applying for Road Widening Proposals:
To apply, submit a proposal to the concerned PWD Divisional Office, along with required documents such as land ownership records and a detailed project report. The proposal will be reviewed and processed according to PWD guidelines.
answer: To get your road widening plan approved by the PWD in Tamil Nadu, ensure your proposal meets all technical and legal requirements. Submit a detailed plan including feasibility studies, environmental impact assessments, and cost estimates. Follow the prescribed submission process and be prepared for consultations and feedback.
